title: docsearch doesn't show text in Safari
body:
**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

The docsearch inputted text isn't visible.

I didn't immediately see any reason why it wasn't visible in the inspector

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

it should be visible

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**

Safari (I tested 10)

**What project are you opening an issue for?**

* react-instantsearch

safari | chrome
